_comment: Cards that exist only for the life-loss replacement test (tests/unit/players/test_life_loss_replacement.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_bloodletter` is Bloodletter of Aclazotz's shape -- an opponent's life loss doubled, but only during your turn. `t_always_bloodletter` drops the turn condition, so the pair pins that the condition is actually read rather than stored. `t_self_bloodletter` points the same replacement at its own controller, which is the half no printed card has and the only way to test `affects_player` here. `t_drain` and `t_drain_bolt` are the two ways life goes down -- a plain loss and damage -- and `t_lifelink_bolt` is damage from a lifelinking source, which is where doubling the damage rather than the loss would show.
